profiles.description: Coordinates Native AI Engineering work, selects one primary workflow, creates durable Kanban tasks, routes bounded work to specialists, verifies handoffs, and synthesizes evidence without becoming the primary implementer or reviewer.
Owns product intent, user problems, product briefs, PRDs, MVP scope, success criteria, and product acceptance while excluding technical architecture and implementation ownership.

Owns solution boundaries, domain and integration architecture, technical specifications, non-functional requirements, architecture decisions, and implementation guidance without acting as the primary feature implementer.
Owns product experience, user flows, interaction behavior, design-system decisions, responsive intent, accessibility intent, and design acceptance without owning frontend implementation.
Owns frontend architecture and implementation, component behavior, state and API integration, accessibility implementation, responsive behavior, frontend tests, and implementation evidence.
Owns backend services, APIs, domain and application implementation, persistence, integrations, background work, automated tests, and implementation evidence within approved architecture.
Independently verifies acceptance criteria, architecture conformance, security findings, regressions, tests, and readiness without serving as the primary implementer.
